data.long_meaning: The name Jaram is derived from the Arabic word jarma, which means 'born from hardships.' This name is significant in Islamic history as it was given to a child born to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his wife Khadija (RA) during a time of great hardship and persecution. The name Jaram carries the meaning “Born from hardships” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jaram usually hope their child will grow to embody born from hardships and live with faith, good character and purpose.
